Reconstruction Drive

Target a damaged hex you hold. At the turn: Damaged Infrastructure is removed, it gains Well-Maintained, Defense +2 and Integration +1; an Occupied or Contested hex settles to Claimed at once.

Cost: Economy 15 · Logistics 15 marks.
